author: Jimi nj
title: Great game too many ads
content:
A Great Puzzle Game Hindered by AI Art

This game is genuinely fun, highly engaging, and packs a fantastic challenge. The underlying puzzle mechanics are top-notch and will easily keep you entertained for hours if you enjoy a good mental workout.

However, the game's heavy reliance on AI-generated artwork is a mixed bag. On one hand, the chaotic and surreal details in the AI images add an unexpected layer of difficulty to the puzzles, making them noticeably more challenging to solve. On the other hand, it can become fairly annoying after a while. Many of the pictures look deeply unrealistic, with odd artifacts and unnatural compositions that pull you out of the experience.

If you can look past the quirky, synthetic visual style, the core gameplay and puzzle design are absolute winners. Itâ€™s a great, challenging game that just needs better, more intentional artwork to truly shine.

author: Hay72_
title: Too many ads
content:
I really enjoy the game itself, but the amount of ads between rounds is becoming pretty frustrating. Sometimes the rounds are so short that they actually take less time to play than the ad that follows them. Having to sit through 15–20 seconds of ads after nearly every round makes the overall experience feel more like watching ads than playing the game.

There’s also a fairly long leaderboard animation after each level. I understand wanting to show players their progress, but it would be nice to have an option to skip or shorten it, especially when I’m just trying to keep playing.

At this point, it’s actually faster to completely close and reopen the app after each level than to go through the ads and animations, which obviously isn’t an ideal experience.

I also didn’t really want to leave a public App Store review for this feedback, but I couldn’t find an option within the app to submit feedback directly. Having an in-app feedback option would be a great addition.

I’d definitely consider paying for a lifetime ad-free version if one were available (ideally around $5 or less) would make a huge difference. 

Overall, I like the game and would love to keep playing it—the ads and post-level animations are just making it a bit difficult to enjoy.

author: JanuaryOyster
title: I used to love this game
content:
This was a great game until they added rankings. As soon as you open the game, you have to click buttons over and over while it tells you that one ranking season is over and this was where you ranked. And then there’s a new season and you have to click through, and then you have to wait while it finds players who are ranked the same. And then when you finally get to the place where you’re gonna play the game, as soon as you win, you have to sit there and wait for it to come up with your ranking for that level and then you wait while you watch the animation of your ranking above other people.

I just wanna play the game. There are a lot of games that give you the option to enter that kind of thing but this one does not. You just have to sit there and press buttons and wait and it’s incredibly annoying and frustrating. 

So I play the daily and that’s it. I do not have the patience for all of the animation and forced waiting. I don’t know if I’m even going to bother playing the daily anymore because they just added the part where you have to wait for it to find other players at your level.

It really was a great game.
